create.name: Gemma B. Benton
create.bio:
Gemma B. Benton is a Menominee and Filipino singer of traditional Native songs, a storyteller, painter and spiritual activist living in the Sacramento area of California. Her work centres on ancestral healing: helping people recover a living relationship with the sacred, with their ancestors and with the land, and tending the places where family and collective histories have been broken. She has worked for many years alongside Native community leaders and healers, and she is active in social justice causes in her region, including the movement to remember missing and murdered Indigenous women.

She works one to one over Zoom in long sessions that may combine spiritual counselling, story, guided meditation, tarot or oracle readings, mediumship and the clearing of ancestral patterns, and she also offers longer intensives. As a trained JourneyCircles facilitator she uses collage and intuitive layering of images as a doorway into symbol and soul, and her own paintings, built up from earth pigments, ash and beeswax, are made as a form of prayer. She created the Healing Her Story Oracle, a deck of fifty-five images drawn from her life as a woman of mixed Native heritage, which she uses in her teaching, and she shares short talks on remembering and reclaiming the sacred on her YouTube channel.

courses.title: Ancestral Healing Sessions and Intuitive Readings
courses.description: Private sessions of about ninety minutes on Zoom, shaped to the person and drawing on story, guided meditation, tarot or oracle cards, mediumship and work with ancestral patterns. Sessions are recorded, and VIP days and intensives are also offered.

courses.title: JourneyCircles
courses.description: A creative process she facilitates in which a simple circle is filled with chosen images, symbols and words, as a way of letting the soul speak through collage. It draws on expressive arts and the symbolism of the circle and spiral.

courses.title: Healing Her Story Oracle Deck
courses.description: Her oracle deck of fifty-five images carrying Indigenous stories, language and ritual, meant for reflection with your ancestors and guides rather than prediction. The deck comes with Level 1 video trainings.
courses.price: $35 USD ($45 USD with US shipping; $65 USD to Canada)
